tool.name: lookup_caller_work_en
tool.description: Record lookup: finds the record of the customer registered to this phone number. Use it when the caller asks how existing work, a quote or a visit is going. The result holds only this: known says whether a customer record was found, name is the name on the record, open_items.count is how many open items they have, open_items.next_due is the earliest due date among them (null when none has one), and upcoming_visits lists the dates of visits from today on. You may tell the caller that count and those dates; take a message for anything else.
